title: 2nd Stopping Place 4th Truth Proofs Of Unity Through The Examples Of Spring And Creatures

questions.question: What big season example is used to show Allah’s power in caring for many living things at once?
questions.answer: Spring is used as the example.

questions.question: About how many kinds of plants and animals are mentioned as being made, arranged, and cared for?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand kinds are mentioned.

questions.question: How are those many kinds described as existing at the same time?
questions.answer: They are together and mixed with one another.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in Allah’s work?
questions.answer: It says there is no error or mistake in it.

questions.question: What two qualities are shown in the way these living things are made?
questions.answer: Great wisdom and beautiful skill are shown.

questions.question: What small creature is mentioned at the lower end of bird-like creatures?
questions.answer: Flies are mentioned.

questions.question: What large bird is given as a high example among birds?
questions.answer: Eagles are given as an example.

questions.question: Besides creating birds, what two needs are they given?
questions.answer: They are given what they need to fly and what they need to live on.

questions.question: Where are birds made to travel?
questions.answer: They travel through the sky.

questions.question: What three signs are said to be found in each bird?
questions.answer: A mark of skill on its face, a sign of wisdom on its body, and a sign pointing to Allah’s oneness in its being.

questions.question: What happens to food particles in the body?
questions.answer: They quickly go to help the body’s cells.

questions.question: What do plants do for animals in the passage?
questions.answer: They hurry to help and support animals.

questions.question: How do mothers act toward their weak babies?
questions.answer: They quickly go to help them with wisdom and mercy.

questions.question: What very large things are named to show the wide reach of Allah’s working?
questions.answer: The Milky Way, the solar system, and the elements of the earth are named.

questions.question: What very small things are named to show that Allah’s working reaches tiny details too?
questions.answer: The covering of the eye’s pupil, rose petals, corn husks, and melon seeds are named.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how Allah works on many levels at once?
questions.answer: The passage compares it to circles crossing through one another.

questions.question: What truth is proven by all these examples together?
questions.answer: They show clearly that the One doing all this is one and unique.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah being near and far?
questions.answer: Nothing contains Him, but He is present everywhere; everything is far from Him, yet He is near to everything.

questions.question: What comparison shows that huge and tiny things are equally easy for Allah?
questions.answer: Very great things like the Milky Way are no harder for Him than tiny things like blood cells or even thoughts in a heart.

questions.question: What are believers asked to say as the simple return for Allah’s many blessings?
questions.answer: They should begin with “In the name of Allah” and end with “Praise be to Allah.”

questions.question: What main idea does the spring example teach about Allah?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah can create and manage countless living things all at once with perfect control.

questions.question: Why is spring a strong example in this passage?
questions.answer: Because in spring many different living things appear together in huge numbers.

questions.question: How are the many species arranged in relation to one another?
questions.answer: They are mixed together but still kept in order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the quality of this ordering?
questions.answer: It is done perfectly, wisely, and beautifully.

questions.question: Why are both flies and eagles mentioned?
questions.answer: They show that Allah creates creatures from very small to very great within the same group.

questions.question: After birds are created, what care is given to them?
questions.answer: They are equipped for flying and for getting their food.

questions.question: What does each bird’s special look suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests careful design and skill.

questions.question: What does the sign within each bird point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What does it show when food particles go to body cells quickly?
questions.answer: It shows wise care and organized help inside living things.

questions.question: What does it show when plants help animals?
questions.answer: It shows that living things are connected in a planned system.

questions.question: What does the behavior of mothers toward their babies show?
questions.answer: It shows mercy and care placed in creation.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both the Milky Way and the pupil of the eye?
questions.answer: To show that the same power works in the biggest and smallest things.

questions.question: What idea is taught by the image of intersecting circles?
questions.answer: Many levels of creation are all under one ordered control at the same time.

questions.question: What conclusion is drawn from all these signs?
questions.answer: The Maker of all of them must be one and unique.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying Allah is not contained in a place but is present everywhere?
questions.answer: It means He is not limited like creation, yet His knowledge and power reach all things.

questions.question: What examples show that hidden small things are also known by Allah?
questions.answer: The cells in human blood and the thoughts passing through the heart.

questions.question: How does the passage explain that many and great things are easy for Allah?
questions.answer: It says a huge thing is just as easy for Him as a tiny and rare thing.

questions.question: What examples show growth from small to large in creation?
questions.answer: A fly compared with an eagle, a seed compared with a tree, a tree compared with a garden, and a spring compared with a resurrection.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the blessings Allah gives people?
questions.answer: They are extremely valuable, yet He gives them freely and easily.

questions.question: What is the thankful response asked from people?
questions.answer: They should remember Allah at the start and praise Him at the end.

questions.question: In this passage, what season is connected with the appearance of countless living things?
questions.answer: The season is spring.

questions.question: What kinds of living things are especially mentioned in the large number of species?
questions.answer: Plants and animals are especially mentioned.

questions.question: What number helps readers understand how many species are being discussed?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: Are these species kept apart or placed together in the description?
questions.answer: They are described as being together and mixed.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this huge work?
questions.answer: It says the work is done without mistakes.

questions.question: Which group of creatures is used as a special example after the general talk about plants and animals?
questions.answer: Birds are used as a special example.

questions.question: How is a fly connected to birds in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as a tiny bird-like example.

questions.question: Why is an eagle mentioned with the fly?
questions.answer: It shows the highest and strongest example in that group.

questions.question: What are birds supplied with besides being created?
questions.answer: They are supplied with the ability to fly and with provision.

questions.question: What part of each bird shows artistic making?
questions.answer: Its face shows a mark of artistic making.

questions.question: What part of each bird shows wisdom?
questions.answer: Its body shows a seal of wisdom.

questions.question: What part of each bird points to Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: Its inner being points to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Give one example from the passage of help happening inside a living body.
questions.answer: Food particles rush to assist the body’s cells.

questions.question: Give one example from the passage of help between living things outside the body.
questions.answer: Plants help animals, or mothers help their helpless babies.

questions.question: What opposite ends of creation are named to show the wide reach of Allah’s action?
questions.answer: Very great things like the Milky Way and very tiny things like eye coverings or seeds.

questions.question: What do all these examples make certain to the reader?
questions.answer: They make it clear that the One doing all this is one and unique.

questions.question: What sun comparison is used to explain Allah’s nearness and greatness?
questions.answer: Everything is far from Him while He is near to everything, like a comparison drawn with the sun.

questions.question: What hidden human things are mentioned to show Allah knows small details?
questions.answer: Blood cells and thoughts in the heart are mentioned.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by saying a seed can be made like a tree and a tree like a garden?
questions.answer: Allah’s power easily brings great results from small beginnings.

questions.question: What two short phrases are taught as the right way to receive blessings?
questions.answer: “In the name of Allah” at the beginning and “Praise be to Allah” at the end.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens every spring that points to Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: Huge numbers of plants and animals are created, arranged, and cared for all at once.

questions.question: How many species are mentioned in that spring scene?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species are mentioned.

questions.question: What does the passage emphasize about the way these species are handled together?
questions.answer: They are handled together in an ordered way without confusion or mistakes.

questions.question: What does this careful order tell us about the One who made them?
questions.answer: It shows the Maker is wise and perfect in skill.

questions.question: Why does the passage move from all species to the example of birds?
questions.answer: It uses birds to show detailed signs of care in one group of creatures.

questions.question: What range of birds is described?
questions.answer: It goes from tiny fly-like examples to mighty eagles.

questions.question: What needs of birds are met after they are created?
questions.answer: Their flying and their daily provision are taken care of.

questions.question: What is meant by a mark on each bird’s face and body?
questions.answer: Each bird carries signs of design and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say is found in the very being of each bird?
questions.answer: A sign that points to Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What examples show that help in creation is fast and purposeful?
questions.answer: Food helps cells, plants support animals, and mothers hurry to their babies.

questions.question: What good qualities are seen in the way mothers help their babies?
questions.answer: Wisdom and mercy are seen.

questions.question: Why are both giant heavenly systems and tiny plant parts mentioned together?
questions.answer: To show the same order and artistry appear in everything from largest to smallest.

questions.question: What image helps explain many levels of creation working under one command?
questions.answer: The image of overlapping circles.

questions.question: What certain conclusion comes from this long list of examples?
questions.answer: The One acting in all of them is one and has one stamp on everything.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah and place?
questions.answer: He is not limited by place, yet His presence reaches every place.

questions.question: How does the passage compare Allah’s relation to things with the sun?
questions.answer: Created things are distant from Him, but He is close to them all.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s knowledge of private human matters?
questions.answer: Even blood cells and passing thoughts are known to Him.

questions.question: How does the passage show that large and small creations are equally easy for Allah?
questions.answer: It says He creates tiny and huge things with the same ease.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the blessings given to people?
questions.answer: They are precious and beautifully made, yet given at little cost to us.

questions.question: What is the “price” asked from people for these blessings?
questions.answer: To remember Allah by saying His name before things and thanking Him after them.

questions.question: What yearly event is used to help us think about Allah’s power and care?
questions.answer: The event is spring.

questions.question: In spring, what two broad groups of living things are said to be created and sustained?
questions.answer: Plants and animals.

questions.question: What does the huge number of species teach a student about Allah’s ability?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah can care for countless kinds at the same time.

questions.question: When so many species are mixed together, what problem does the passage say does not happen?
questions.answer: Disorder and mistakes do not happen.

questions.question: What two beautiful qualities are named in this creation?
questions.answer: Wisdom and artistic perfection.

questions.question: Which creature stands for the small end of the bird examples?
questions.answer: The fly does.

questions.question: Which creature stands for the great end of the bird examples?
questions.answer: The eagle does.

questions.question: What blessings are given to birds after their creation?
questions.answer: They are given ways to fly and ways to find their food.

questions.question: What do the special features on every bird show?
questions.answer: They show careful design, wisdom, and a sign of Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What action of food particles shows organization inside the body?
questions.answer: They quickly go where the cells need help.

questions.question: What action of plants shows support among living things?
questions.answer: They rush to help animals.

questions.question: What action of mothers shows mercy in creation?
questions.answer: They go quickly to care for their helpless young.

questions.question: What is the point of naming things from the Milky Way to melon seeds?
questions.answer: The point is that Allah’s work covers everything from the greatest to the smallest.

questions.question: What does the phrase about circles crossing one another help you imagine?
questions.answer: It helps me imagine many connected levels of order working together.

questions.question: What single belief do these examples support?
questions.answer: They support belief that Allah is one and unique.

questions.question: What does it mean that Allah’s mark is on all things?
questions.answer: It means all creation shows signs that it belongs to Him.

questions.question: How does the passage explain that Allah is beyond distance and closeness as we know them?
questions.answer: He is not limited by place, yet He is near to everything by His power and knowledge.

questions.question: What small hidden things are not beyond Allah’s power?
questions.answer: The cells in human blood and the thoughts in the heart.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by the examples of fly and eagle, seed and tree, tree and garden?
questions.answer: Allah can make small things into great outcomes with complete ease.

questions.question: According to the passage, how should a Muslim respond to Allah’s blessings in daily life?
questions.answer: A Muslim should begin with Allah’s name and end with praise to Him.

questions.question: What natural season is described as a sign full of living examples?
questions.answer: Spring is described that way.

questions.question: What happens in that season to many kinds of creatures?
questions.answer: Many kinds are created, arranged, and provided for.

questions.question: About how many species are mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: About four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the timing and sameness of this work?
questions.answer: It happens together, in one moment, and in the same ordered way.

questions.question: What does the absence of mistakes show about Allah’s actions?
questions.answer: It shows perfect knowledge, wisdom, and control.

questions.question: Which class of animals is described in more detail after that?
questions.answer: Birds are described in more detail.

questions.question: What two examples show the range within that class?
questions.answer: Flies and eagles.

questions.question: What are birds prepared with so they can live properly?
questions.answer: They are prepared with flight and provision.

questions.question: What three kinds of signs are placed on each bird?
questions.answer: Signs of artistry, wisdom, and Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What example shows support happening at the tiniest level inside bodies?
questions.answer: Food particles moving to help body cells.

questions.question: What example shows one part of creation helping another?
questions.answer: Plants helping animals.

questions.question: What example shows care placed in family life among creatures?
questions.answer: Mothers hurrying to help their weak babies.

questions.question: What very large things and very small things are named side by side?
questions.answer: The Milky Way and solar system are named with the eye’s pupil, rose petals, corn husks, and melon seeds.

questions.question: Why does the passage join these giant and tiny examples together?
questions.answer: To show the same order, skill, and wisdom are present in all of them.

questions.question: What final statement is established with clear certainty after these examples?
questions.answer: That the One doing all these works is one and unique.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by saying Allah has His mark on all things?
questions.answer: Every created thing carries signs that point back to Him.

questions.question: What comparison is used to help explain Allah’s closeness to all things?
questions.answer: A comparison with the sun is used.

questions.question: What hidden parts of human life are said to be fully known and within Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Blood cells and the thoughts crossing the heart.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the difficulty of creating great and small things?
questions.answer: For Allah, huge and tiny things are equally easy.

questions.question: What are the two short sayings the passage teaches as our response to blessings?
questions.answer: Say “In the name of Allah” at the beginning and “Praise be to Allah” at the end.
